newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan police arrest gas spill truck driver.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan police arrest gas spill truck driver.

text.p: Pakistan police on Thursday arrested the driver of a truck which leaked chlorine gas last week, killing at least 20 people and injuring 1,000 in the Punjab capital of Lahore, a senior official said.

Lahore's administrator, Deputy Commissioner Kamran Lashari, told Reuters he hoped the driver, who had fled after the January 8 accident, would be able to explain unanswered questions about the leak from faulty nozzles of two gas cylinders on board the truck.
Witnesses said the driver ran away from the leaking truck after it became stuck in a ditch. Doctors earlier put the death toll at 32.
Most of the victims had either run towards the truck or bolted themselves in their nearby homes, Lashari said.
Rescuers could not get near because their masks were ineffective against chlorine, he said.
